trends.whatProductOffers: A participating savings plan that pays guaranteed cash payments of 2.1% of the principal amount each policy year, plus an additional 0.4% of principal each year until the end of the 20th policy year.

keyFigures.label: Annual guaranteed cash payment
keyFigures.condition: at the end of each policy year until the insured reaches age 100

keyFigures.label: Additional guaranteed cash payment
keyFigures.condition: at the end of each policy year until the end of the 20th policy year

exclusionsOrConditions: The 2.1% and 0.4% are calculated on the principal amount, not on the accumulated value.
The principal amount is not payable as a death benefit except under the accidental death benefit.
Annual Dividends begin only from the end of the 10th policy year and are not guaranteed.
Terminal Dividend requires the policy to be in force for 10 years or more and is not guaranteed.

trends.trendName: Waiver of premium on parent death
trends.whatProductOffers: The basic policy includes a Waiver of Premium on Death (Parents) or (Spouse) benefit: if the parent of an insured child or the spouse of an insured adult dies before age 80, all or part of future premiums are waived.

keyFigures.label: Waiver trigger
keyFigures.value: Death of the insured child's parent, or the insured adult's spouse

keyFigures.label: Waiver scope
keyFigures.value: All or part of future premiums for the basic plan

keyFigures.label: Child cover extension
keyFigures.value: Premiums waived for the insured child until age 25

keyFigures.label: Qualifying period
keyFigures.value: Policy must be in force for 2 years

exclusionsOrConditions: The parent or spouse must be age 50 or below at the time of application (the excerpt is cut off at this condition).
The benefit becomes effective only after the policy has been in force for 2 years.
Only all or part of future premiums are waived; the death benefit itself is unaffected.
No health information is required for this benefit.

trends.whatProductOffers: On death the beneficiary receives the higher of the guaranteed cash value or 105% of total basic-plan premiums paid net of guaranteed cash payments, plus accumulated cash payments, accumulated dividends and any Terminal Dividend.

keyFigures.label: Death benefit floor
keyFigures.value: Higher of guaranteed cash value or 105% of total premiums paid less guaranteed cash payments

keyFigures.label: Accidental death benefit
keyFigures.value: Principal amount of the basic plan
keyFigures.condition: death from a covered accident within the first 12 months

keyFigures.label: Accidental death cap
keyFigures.condition: maximum aggregate across all FLCP5 policies for the same insured

exclusionsOrConditions: The 105% floor is calculated after deducting guaranteed cash payments already paid.
The accidental death benefit applies only within the first 12 months and only for a covered accident.
The accidental death benefit is capped at US$100,000 aggregate per insured across all policies.
All outstanding debt is deducted before payment to the beneficiary.
